verdict.rationale: Notte's docs show scriptable, schedulable automations deployed as API endpoints and scalable remote browsers, which could in principle be used to run tasks across many items, but there is no explicit documentation or example of batch/bulk processing (e.g., looping over lists of URLs or items) as a first-class feature. missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch execution feature or example, parallel session orchestration for many items, evidence of throughput/rate limits for large-scale runs.
